_comment: Node Semantics Catalog. Per nodeKey: a plain-finance meaning + a param gloss. The AI planner reads this (alongside StrategyFacts) to turn an IR node into accurate narration, instead of guessing what an indicator does. `paramGloss` maps a param name to a short phrase the planner can weave in.

ohlcv.data.name: Candles
ohlcv.data.meaning: Loads the raw OHLCV price history — the candle data every strategy reads from.

ta.macd.name: MACD
ta.macd.meaning: Moving Average Convergence Divergence — tracks momentum by comparing a fast and a slow moving average, with a signal line for crossovers.

ta.ema.name: EMA
ta.ema.meaning: Exponential Moving Average — a trend line that weights recent prices more heavily.

ta.rsi.name: RSI
ta.rsi.meaning: Relative Strength Index — an oscillator from 0-100 that flags overbought and oversold conditions.

crossover.name: Crossover
crossover.meaning: Fires when the first input crosses ABOVE the second — a classic bullish trigger.

crossunder.name: Crossunder
crossunder.meaning: Fires when the first input crosses BELOW the second — a classic bearish trigger.

np.greater.name: Greater Than
np.greater.meaning: True while the first input is greater than the second.

np.less.name: Less Than
np.less.meaning: True while the first input is less than the second.

plot.name: Plot
plot.meaning: Draws a series onto the chart so its behaviour is visible.
